_: Per-file budgets for raw HTML controls in ui/src, read by
scripts/gates/ds_components.py. THIS FILE IS THE ALLOWLIST — it is the one
source, and docs/architecture/ui.md 11.6 links here rather than restating it.
A budget is a ceiling, not a target. The gate fails when a file exceeds its
budget, and when a file not listed here uses a raw control at all. It does
NOT fail when a count drops: ratchet the number down as the debt clears.
'bespoke' means a deliberate exception — no DS component fits.
'debt' means deferred migration tracked by an issue. Debt is not an
exception; it is a number that should be going down.

ui/src/App.tsx.note: Settings info buttons, vault switcher, tree-row rename input, doc-title input.

ui/src/omnibar/OmniBar.tsx.note: The ranked multi-kind palette. The flat DS CommandPalette would regress fuzzy rank, kind badges and recency. This is the one surface architecture/ui.md 11.6 names.

ui/src/sidebar/IntegrityPanel.tsx.note: Occurrence row, opens the source file.
